summary: Take-Two Interactive Software filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, reporting entry into a new long-term Xbox Publisher License Agreement with Microsoft, effective September 17, 2026. The agreement grants Take-Two rights to develop, publish, market, and sell Xbox-compatible products, and supersedes all prior Xbox publisher license agreements. Microsoft pays wholesale price or an agreed revenue share on digitally delivered content; Microsoft charges fees and royalties for physical media. Either party may terminate for material breach or insolvency. No special-situation transaction terms apply.
